title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 114 Center Street East in Roseau, Minnesota, as the "Floyd B. Olson Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 114 Center Street East in Roseau, Minnesota, as the Floyd B. Olson Post Office.

summary.headline: Congress named the post office at 114 Center Street East in Roseau, Minnesota, the Floyd B. Olson Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives an official name to a U.S. Postal Service facility in Roseau, Minnesota. The building is now called the Floyd B. Olson Post Office. It does not change how mail is delivered or how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
